I replied to Pree in her DM to confirm the change: Tamsyn Tolland is now her go-to escalation contact at Tansley Parcel for the Driftwood rollout.

Her DM was already saved automatically in gbrain, and only she can see it there. I didn't save another copy with `remember`, because that tool doesn't clearly keep a fact private to one member, and a second copy could have been visible to others. Nothing was posted in any channel or shared with anyone else.
